text.en: Clients praise Wei, Andy, and the salon team for their warmth, friendliness, and dedication to pet wellbeing. Reviewers appreciate that the groomers listen carefully to styling preferences and never give up on difficult cases. Former students also commend the instructors for supportive, hands-on teaching during grooming diploma courses.

Pet parents express high satisfaction with the grooming results, highlighting tidy wash and cut services, breed-specific poodle styling, and smooth coat finishes. Clients note that dogs look well-groomed and smell fresh following their appointments. Owners of golden retrievers and cocker spaniels appreciate the precision of the cuts.

Reviewers emphasize how gently animals are treated, particularly dogs that suffer from severe grooming anxiety or pre-existing injuries. Owners note that groomers take extra precautions around sensitive areas and help nervous pets feel comfortable. Families trust the team to handle first-time puppies and senior dogs with genuine care.

q.en: Where is Paws Solutions Pet Grooming located?

a.en: The grooming salon is located at 19 Maypark on Malahide Road in Donnycarney, Dublin.

q.en: Can the salon accommodate anxious or nervous dogs?

a.en: Yes, reviewers specifically note that staff are exceptionally gentle and patient with anxious dogs and pets with minor injuries.
Yes, grooming sessions at Paws Solutions are arranged by appointment.

q.en: Does Paws Solutions provide grooming training courses?

a.en: Yes, reviewers mention completing professional Level 3 dog grooming diploma training and upskilling courses at the salon.
